correctness.rationale: Classical Radić area identity is independently checked with 600 explicit tangent-geometry constructions; exact three-branch monotonicity in the tangent variable proves the CDF. Symbolic differentiation plus a 36-entry rational nonnegative Bernstein certificate proves strict decrease for every 0<d<1 and all angles. Uniform Taylor expansion yields the normalized threefold arcsine limit. Exact polynomial identities and numeric checks are reproduced by verify.py; no finite experiment is substituted for the infinite proof.

The strict order is proved using a new explicit rational Bernstein positivity certificate rather than merely a substitution.

value.rationale: Natural uniform sampling from the fixed outer circle assigns different weights to triangles of the same porism; its full area distribution has a three-branch inversion. A strict area order across all offsets supplies a nontrivial geometric comparison, and a third-harmonic arcsine scaling reveals a collapsed nearly equilateral regime. This supplies useful probabilistic geometry beyond a known deterministic extrema formula.
